requirements.text: Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Analytics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical field.
We primarily target students in their final year of study and will also consider strong juniors.
Strong SQL skills and comfort working with structured datasets.
Experience using Python for data analysis, scripting, or automation.
Coursework or hands-on experience in data engineering, analytics, data science, databases, or a related area.
Familiarity with Git or another source-control system.
Ability to investigate data carefully, recognize when results do not make sense, and validate conclusions.
Strong technical problem-solving skills and willingness to work through ambiguous or unfamiliar problems.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience with BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform, or another cloud data warehouse/platform.
Familiarity with dbt or another SQL-based data transformation framework.
Exposure to dimensional modeling concepts, including star schemas or Kimball-style modeling.
Experience building dashboards or reports in Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or a similar BI tool.
Familiarity with data pipelines, ETL/ELT, workflow orchestration, or tools such as Airflow.
Experience with pandas, Jupyter notebooks, or other Python data tooling.
Experience writing automated data tests, monitoring data quality, or documenting analytical models and metrics.
Personal data, software, analytics, or AI projects outside of coursework.
Previous internship, research, or project experience involving data engineering, analytics engineering, BI, or data science.
Experience using AI-assisted coding, LLMs, or automation tools to accelerate analysis or software development, with good judgment around validating generated output.
Interest in building conversational or natural-language interfaces over structured data.
